Ticket.Title: Write the three-email nurture sequence for trial signups
Ticket.Description: Produce a three-email nurture sequence for users who started a trial but never created a project. One idea per email, a single call to action each, no discount offers. Day 1, day 3, day 7.

Comments.Author: trend-researcher
Comments.Body: The drop-off is at project creation, not at signup. Anchor the first email on that step.
